judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: So the great person keeps the brightness going,
lines: Flame of the sun slanting down.
Not drumming on a pot, and singing —
then the lament of great age.
In triumph he beheads the chief;
those caught are not of his party.

notes.name_en: 離 is light clinging to what it burns; 'Flame', not Wilhelm's 'The Clinging, Fire'.
notes.L6: 折首 beheading (the chief); 獲匪其醜 the captives are not of their own company — i.e. not wantonly taken.
